brief: A habit tracker as a garden — daily completion waters plants, streaks bloom, neglect wilts

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor: sky-to-soil gradient with sun and plants makes the garden concept immediately legible and emotionally warm
Plant growth states map cleanly to streak length, giving an honest visual encoding of habit health
Stats panel is restrained and well-aligned, providing reflective summary without competing with the scene
dominant_weaknesses: Habit chips and garden plots feel like two disconnected layers — selecting a chip should visibly tie to its plant, but spacing and alignment drift
Plants are tiny relative to the vast empty soil band, wasting the most emotionally charged area of the canvas
Emoji-driven chips clash with the otherwise illustrated, bespoke garden aesthetic, weakening craft coherence
fix_priorities: Vertically align each habit chip directly above its plant column to lock the metaphor
Scale plants up and add ground-level detail (grass, watering cues) so the soil zone earns its real estate
Replace emoji with custom glyphs matching the plant illustrations for unified craft
Introduce subtle motion (sway, water droplets, wilt) to deliver on the brief's living-system promise
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral charm from the garden scene leads, reflective stats support it, but behavioral feedback loops (watering, wilting, interaction affordances) are underdeveloped.
rationale.intent_fit: The metaphor is clearly executed and distinctive, but without visible watering/wilting states or interaction cues it reads as a static illustration rather than a living habit system.
